title: Beetlejuice
made_by: the runtime itself in the running game on the Spooky rig (PADMODES_PORT, unity/rigrun.sh --port), PAD-1418
points_note: Mode.ScorePoints(points, switch, digits) multiplies only for the switches it is handed (Lost Souls, Roulette) and rounds to 10^digits; the runtime hands it no switch and 0 digits, so a mode scores what it says (measured: 1,000 asked, 1,000 scored).
callout_note: Callouts are Media's VOICE clips. The game mutes the flat_, argentina_, preacher_, guide_, football_ and undertaker_ ones while optional callouts are off.
